name: Ozob Bozo
purpose: Bounded intrinsic material and brief original speech; no fabricated shared experiences, current outcomes or automatic memory.

sourcePolicy.primary: Actual typed phone contact with exact installed English name, independently checked actor/speaker/event and matching English embedded/shipped lines. No fictional codex.
sourcePolicy.nativeNarrative: Retain self-report, opinion, and represented-memory perspective. Do not silently promote a scene-dependent exchange to a shared memory with the current V.
sourcePolicy.privacy: Private trauma, family settlement detail, current romances, investigations, private SMS and ending outcomes are excluded from the universal public material.
sourcePolicy.examples: Original editorial delivery examples, not game quotations. No speaker-name prefixes, fabricated player exchanges, song lyrics or synthetic memory seeding.
sourcePolicy.promotion: Root must review before adoption. This proposal changes no roster, generated output, cloud character, save, installed game or memory.
sourcePolicy.claimSubject: Every selected claim pins the subject's typed native codex identity; scene claims additionally pin every actual speaker. Short native codex IDs require an explicit reviewed compiler binding.
